current: All four named record kinds reach the cell only inside HMAC-signed, cell-bound records verified before the cell acts: capital grants (qip_edge::envelope::VerifiedEnvelope::verify, and the capital_grants slot), kill/fence (qip_edge::policy::VerifiedHalt::verify), and - as slots of the signed PolicyPayload whose signing_payload digests every slot (qip-contracts/src/policy.rs:710-745) - the risk envelope (risk_envelope, produced by qip-api mesh.rs:930) and model activation (trained_models, produced at mesh.rs:973; Cell::check_models_promoted refuses a plan whose model the verified manifest does not name). Cell::apply_policy/apply_halt take only the Verified* types.
evidence: backend/crates/libs/qip-contracts/src/policy.rs:600,606,608,710-745 (trained_models, capital_grants, risk_envelope slots; every slot digested into the signature)
gap: Signatures are symmetric HMAC-SHA256 (ADR 0043 §2), so a record 'signed by a key outside the control-signing domain' cannot be told apart from one minted by any holder of the verifying key - every verifier can sign. The risk_envelope slot is signed and verified but no cell code consumes it (no reference in qip-edge/src), so 'acts only after verification' is vacuous for it. There is no P0 Critical Control topic: ADR 0100's fabric is decided but not built, and these records travel on the plaintext mesh. And this runs only in qip-edge-node, which no environment deploys.
verification: Existing: cell.rs::an_unsigned_envelope_cannot_become_a_verified_one, ::tampering_with_any_bound_invalidates_the_signature, ::a_policy_payload_verifies_only_with_the_right_key_cell_and_bytes; model_manifest.rs::a_plan_is_admitted_only_when_the_manifest_names_its_model_at_its_own_digest. Needed: asymmetric control signing (ADR 0043 §4) so a consumer can reject a key outside the control-signing domain, a cell consumer of the risk envelope, and the same verification on the fabric's P0 class once ADR 0100's build lands.
notes: deployable=false for the same reason as SEC-001/016: this only runs inside qip-edge-node, and execution_nodes = {} everywhere. verify: status kept; current and gap corrected. The row said no signed record exists for a risk envelope or a model activation; both are slots of the HMAC-signed PolicyPayload that qip-api produces and the cell verifies before applying, and the model manifest gates plan admission with its own test. What keeps this PARTIAL is symmetric keys, an unconsumed risk-envelope slot, no P0 topic, and no deployed node.
